Inside every gift page

Not a card. A whole little experience.

They don't just read your gift — they open it, tap through it and make a wish at the end. Here's the journey every page takes them on.

The finale: they blow out three candle flames, one tap at a time, and lock in a wish. Try the mini version in point 6 →

  1. The sealed envelope

    Your gift arrives as a link. It opens to a sealed envelope with their name on it — and a burst of confetti the moment they break the seal, with your song playing.

  2. The countdown

    A live countdown to their big day builds the suspense before the page unfolds — perfect when you send the link a little early.

  3. The letter

    Your words, written like a letter — not a caption, not a status. The things you'd never say out loud land differently when they're written down.

  4. The polaroids

    Your favourite photos together, styled as polaroids with your captions under each one. Tap any photo to see it full-screen.

  5. Six little cards

    Six flip-cards they tap open, one by one — reasons you love them, favourite memories, inside jokes. Yours to write; we help if you're stuck.

  6. The candle wish

    It ends the way every birthday should: three candles, three taps, one wish — locked in just for them.

    Try it now — tap each flame to blow it out:

Start my gift page

Why so simple?

Because a gift shouldn't need a comparison table. Every page is built by hand for one person — no templates with their name pasted in, no app for them to install. The link opens in any phone browser, instantly.

The split payment is deliberate: ₹100 starts the work, ₹99 is paid only when you see the finished page and love it. If we wouldn't send it to our own favourite person, we redo it.

Need it faster, or for a date that's very close? Mention it in your DM — if we can make it in time, we will, at the same ₹199.

Questions

Before you ask in DM

Can I see a sample before paying anything?

Yes — and you should. DM “GIFT” to @giftpagewala and ask for the sample: you'll get to open the full birthday demo yourself, envelope, song, candles and all, before a single rupee moves.

What exactly do I need to send?

Five things: your name and theirs, 3–6 photos together, a short message (we'll help you write it if you're stuck), a song if you have one, and the special date. It all happens inside one Instagram DM conversation.

How fast will my page be ready?

Within 24 hours of receiving your details and the ₹100 starting payment. Order at least a day before the occasion and your link will be sitting ready before you need it.

How do I pay?

By UPI, in two parts: ₹100 to start your page, and ₹99 when it's delivered and you've seen it. We never ask for full payment upfront.

What does the birthday person actually receive?

One link, from you. They tap it and the gift opens in their phone browser — no app, no sign-up, no downloads. Send it on WhatsApp, DM, or hide it behind a QR code in a card if you're feeling fancy.

What's the Group Page?

Our newest page, made for birthdays with a whole gang behind them. One organiser collects a photo and a few lines from up to 10 friends; we build one page with a flip-card from everyone, plus the envelope opening, a gang letter, polaroids and the candle finale. It's ₹299 — ₹150 to start, ₹149 on delivery. There's a live demo on this page: open it and tap through Priya's gang.

Is it only for birthdays?

Birthdays are the favourite, but the same page works beautifully for anniversaries, proposals, Mother's Day, farewells, thank-yous and “just because”. Tell us the occasion in your DM and we'll tune the words and the finale to it.
